facilities.webp: Lossless re-encoding from the existing native JPG photographs, preserving source pixels instead of a second lossy compression pass.

conroe.treatment: Untouched source image. CSS viewport shows the building and yard on the left, hiding the baked-in map graphic.

facilities.aerial_motion: Perspective movement of a flat photograph; not a reconstruction or a Google Earth model. External Earth links use the known Conroe and group-headquarters addresses.

limitations: Most retained legacy parts and several facility photos are limited by their original source resolution. Enlarged inspection now respects natural resolution. AI aerial reconstructions were reviewed and rejected because they altered building and yard details. Native full-resolution photography is needed for further factual quality improvements.
